text: Portable 16-seed court implemented without core changes. NativeStatLaws covers grouped count/bin mass, right-closed interval ownership, range/SE summary bounds, independently integrated fixed-bandwidth density, radial line/filled-contour topology, and declared-order permutation invariance. NativePositionLaws covers identity, bounded deterministic jitter, Total/Single non-overlapping dodge, signed stack, and both explicit stack orders. SeededLaw annotates returned failures and caught exceptions with exact replay seeds. lawsJVM and lawsJS pass 18 tests each; scoped formatting checks pass. Full repository gate remains.
